items.title: Curtis Mitchell Interview, 1996-04-02
items.q: So I was in, that's Mr. Kitty. Well that's. So he left with Danny Stead to pay me, see.

ctx.x: The kitty. You know, that was coming, the kitty. So man, we was at the Club Sands. The kitty wasn't much, you know, but four or five dollars a night. But when this guy started coming every night, man, I used to bring home 70, 80, 100, 150 dollars a night, you know. Because sometimes the cat said, man, well, you're going to pay a little over. And you know, and them cats wasn't fucking, they wasn't getting nothing. So I said, well man, look, I'll pay you all for whatever. You know? So what happened, man? The cat…
